purpose: Teach: なぁー/夕べ/損なう/曲がり/崩さ/行き方/引き続い/ごくごく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、「なぁー、テスト難しかったなぁ」だろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're totally going to say "ugh, that test was so hard," aren't you?
lines.style: Wry, playful mimicry of his predictable complaint. Light teasing tone, gentle eye-roll underneath. Quick setup, slight slowdown on the exaggerated sigh.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夕べ徹夜して大丈夫か、桜
lines.en: You pulled an all-nighter last night — you okay, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuinely checking in, not accusatory. Softly curious, like he noticed something off about her. Slight concern underneath the casual surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、友達との関係を損なうのは止めろよ
lines.en: Riku, don't mess up our friendship with that kind of thing.
lines.style: Firmer than before, protective tone. Not quite a joke anymore. Serious underneath but still delivered as if testing whether he'll actually listen.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のノート、字に曲がりがあって読みにくいぞ、桜
lines.en: Your handwriting's all slanted in your notes — hard to read, Sakura.
lines.style: Observational, not mean-spirited. Pointing something out because he noticed, the way he notices everything. Wry but factual.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、姿勢を崩さないで勉強しろよ
lines.en: Riku, keep your posture straight when you study, will you?
lines.style: Quick, practical advice delivered like a mild scold. Not lecturing — just saying it plainly, as if it matters to her that he takes care of himself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、進路の行き方を考えろよ、桜
lines.en: You need to think about what you're doing with your future, Sakura.
lines.style: Slower, more serious. Weight behind it — this is something he's thought about. Not pushing hard, but not dodging it either.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、引き続いて部活頑張れ
lines.en: Riku, keep pushing with club activities — you're doing great.
lines.style: Genuine encouragement, not performed cheerleading. Warm and direct. The kind of thing she says when she actually means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジュースをごくごく飲みすぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You're drinking way too much juice, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry closing observation. Small smile underneath. Affectionate teasing — the kind that says he's been watching her habits.
